children: Shares of Centrus Energy fell after a $500 million public offering of its stock and warrants was priced.
The stock declined 7.2% to $168.51 on Thursday. Shares have lost more than a third of their value year to date.
Centrus late Wednesday said it will sell 500,000 shares of its Class A common stock for $199.64 apiece.

The company will also sell pre-funded warrants to purchase roughly 2.01 million shares of Class A common stock, as well as common warrants to purchase an aggregate of 6.99 million shares of common stock. The pre-funded warrants will be priced at $199.54 apiece, equal to the public offering price for common stock, minus a 10-cent exercise price.
Centrus expects the offering to close on or about Friday, subject to customary closing conditions.

Gross proceeds from the offering are projected to be about $500 million. Centrus said it intends to use proceeds for general working capital and corporate purposes, which could include technology investments, debt payments and potential acquisitions.
